title: Debias
description: Check bias, framing, assumptions, perspective, and map-versus-territory errors. Use to challenge a read before trusting it, or route to a specific debias model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Decide
description: Improve decisions using reversibility, risk, pre-mortems, red teams, prioritization, and adaptive decision loops. Use directly or route to a decision model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Diagnose
description: Find root causes and analyze failures without jumping to the first explanation. Use for debugging, incidents, process failures, or routing to a diagnosis model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Forecast
description: Estimate probabilities, ranges, uncertainty, calibration, and plausible outcomes. Use for forecasting, sizing uncertainty, or routing to a specific forecasting model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Incentives
description: Analyze second-order consequences, incentives, tradeoffs, strategic interaction, opportunity cost, and value over time. Use directly or route to an incentives model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Reason
description: Test claims, assumptions, explanations, evidence, and first principles. Use for general reasoning or to route to a specific reasoning model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Strategy
description: Build coherent strategy across objectives, tradeoffs, competition, innovation, product direction, and execution. Use directly or route to a strategy model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Systems
description: Analyze interacting components, dependencies, feedback, constraints, bottlenecks, and leverage. Use for cross-component problems or route to a systems model at micro, focused, or full depth.

title: Model Router
description: Route a task to the smallest useful combination of think families/models, choose micro/focused/full depth, and orchestrate them as one process. Use when the right thinking approach is unclear or mixed.

title: Workflows
description: 'Run one of six integrated repeatable workflows: evaluate, decide, plan, debug, verify-claim, or debias. Each composes thinking models into one process and returns one workflow deliverable.'

title: Persistent ReAct / Reflex
description: Persistent execution-control loop for sequentiality, scope, downstream effects, verification, reflection, and adaptive escalation. Loaded by think entry skills; not a public category.

title: Causal Loop Diagrams
description: "Map cause-and-effect relationships with reinforcing/balancing feedback loops to visualize system structure and predict behavior patterns"

title: Graph Thinking
description: "Apply graph-based thinking to visualize complex relationships and solve problems non-linearly. Use when mapping dependencies, analyzing systems, exploring interconnected concepts, or designing architectures."

title: Archetypes
description: "Recognize Senge's Systems Archetypes to diagnose recurring organizational and technical problems, identify why fixes keep failing, and design interventions that address root structure."

title: Feedback Loops
description: "Analyze systems using Donella Meadows' feedback loop framework to identify reinforcing loops, balancing loops, delays, and leverage points. Use for organizational dynamics, product growth design, debugging runaway or oscillating systems, and finding high-impact interventions."

title: Leverage Points
description: "Identify where small changes can have large effects using Donella Meadows' hierarchy of system intervention points. Use for strategic decisions, system optimization, and choosing where to focus engineering effort."

title: Systems
description: "Analyze problems as interconnected systems with feedback loops, emergent behavior, and non-linear effects. Use for debugging complex systems, architecture decisions, and understanding unexpected behavior."

title: Theory Of Constraints
description: "Identify and manage the bottleneck; improvements elsewhere don't matter until the constraint is addressed. Use for performance optimization, process improvement, and resource allocation."

title: Good Strategy Bad Strategy
description: "Craft coherent strategy through diagnosis of core challenge, guiding policy, and coordinated actions when facing complex problems requiring more than goals and aspirations"

title: Pest Analysis
description: "Generate PEST analysis plans with strategic questions and Perplexity AI prompts. Use when user mentions PEST analysis, strategic planning, market analysis, external factors, environmental scanning, or needs research questions for political economic social technological factors."

title: Pest Analysis Critical
description: "Critically evaluate PEST synthesis tables for biases, gaps, and oversights. Use when user mentions critical review, bias assessment, gap analysis, or after completing PEST synthesis."

title: Pest Analysis Execute
description: "Execute PEST analysis by processing research results from Perplexity AI prompts. Create synthesis tables with strategic implications, impact and likelihood ratings. Use when user mentions PEST results, analysis execution, research synthesis, or after generating PEST analysis plans."

title: Pest Analysis Strategy
description: "Transform PEST analysis into actionable strategy: export to CSV, save to Obsidian, create SWOT, define strategic actions, prioritize, and build work plan. Use after completing PEST critical assessment."

title: Pest Analysis Synthesis
description: "Create PEST synthesis tables with strategic implications, impact and likelihood ratings. Use when user mentions synthesis table, strategic recommendations, opportunity threat analysis, or after completing PEST research."

title: Playing To Win
description: "Five-question strategy cascade framework for making integrated strategic choices from winning aspiration to management systems, from P&G's transformation"

title: Porters Five Forces
description: "Systematically assess the competitive intensity and attractiveness of an industry by analyzing five fundamental forces that shape competition and profitability"

title: Effectuation
description: "Start with means, not goals; co-create with partners; leverage contingencies. Use for startup strategy, innovation projects, and uncertain/novel domains where planning is unreliable."

title: Jobs To Be Done
description: "Understand what 'job' users hire your product to do, focusing on progress users seek rather than features. Use for product development, feature prioritization, user research, and market positioning."

title: Triz
description: "Apply TRIZ (Theory of Inventive Problem Solving) methodology to resolve technical contradictions and find innovative solutions. Use for engineering design, breaking through impossible constraints, and systematic innovation."

title: Three Horizons Framework
description: "Balance current business performance with emerging opportunities and future innovation by allocating resources across three time horizons of growth"

title: Chestertons Fence
description: "Before removing something, understand why it was put there in the first place—reforms without understanding cause unintended consequences"

title: Hanlons Razor
description: "Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by incompetence"

title: Hitchens Razor
description: "What can be asserted without evidence can be dismissed without evidence"

title: Humes Guillotine
description: "You cannot derive an 'ought' from an 'is' without bridging logic"

title: Poppers Falsifiability
description: "Scientific theories must be testable and capable of being proven false"

title: Sagan Standard
description: "Calibrate evidence requirements proportional to claim implausibility when evaluating extraordinary assertions"

title: First Principles
description: "Break complex problems into fundamental truths by questioning assumptions and rebuilding from irreducible components. Use for innovation, challenging status quo, or when conventional solutions fail."

title: Occams Razor
description: "Apply parsimony principle to prefer simpler explanations with fewer assumptions. Use for hypothesis selection in debugging, architecture decisions, and choosing between competing approaches."

title: Scientific Method
description: "Hypothesis → Prediction → Test → Revise with explicit falsification. Use for debugging, feature experimentation, performance investigation, and A/B testing design."

title: Socratic
description: "Systematic questioning framework to deepen understanding, challenge assumptions, and uncover hidden beliefs. Use for requirements gathering, debugging, coaching, and critical analysis."

title: Steel Manning
description: "Argue against the strongest version of opposing positions, not the weakest. Use for design reviews, evaluating alternatives, conflict resolution, and decision validation."

title: Thought Experiment
description: "Test ideas through hypothetical scenarios when empirical testing is impractical. Use for architecture evaluation, edge case analysis, ethics considerations, and strategy development."

title: Compound Interest
description: "Leverage exponential growth by reinvesting gains to earn returns on returns, whether in finance, skills, relationships, or habits—small consistent improvements compound into transformational outcomes"

title: Goodharts Law
description: "Anticipate metric gaming and unintended optimization by recognizing that when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure"

title: Incentives
description: "Predict and shape behavior by understanding the hidden rewards and punishments that drive human action"

title: Mechanism Design
description: "Reverse game theory that engineers rules and incentive structures to achieve desired outcomes when participants have private information and self-interested motivations"

title: Nash Equilibrium
description: "Identify stable strategic outcomes where no player benefits from unilaterally changing their strategy - predict where competitive dynamics settle"

title: Principal Agent Problem
description: "Conflicts arising when one party (agent) makes decisions on behalf of another (principal), but their interests diverge and information is asymmetric"

title: Prisoners Dilemma
description: "Recognize situations where individual rational choices lead to collectively worse outcomes - core model for cooperation vs. defection dynamics"

title: Opportunity Cost
description: "Evaluate decisions by what you give up, not just what you gain. Use for resource allocation, prioritization, build vs. buy choices, and technical debt evaluation."

title: Second Order
description: "Think beyond immediate consequences to second and third-order effects. Use for strategic decisions, policy changes, and avoiding unintended consequences."

title: Time Value Of Money
description: "Value money received today higher than the same amount in the future because present money can be invested to earn returns—use Net Present Value to compare cash flows across time and make rational investment decisions"

title: Tit For Tat
description: "Start new business relationships with trust and investment, but immediately match any breach. Return to cooperation as soon as they do. Make the pattern obvious through transparency."

title: Calibration
description: "Align predicted probabilities with actual outcomes - train yourself so things you say are 70% likely actually happen 70% of the time"

title: Monte Carlo Simulation
description: "Probabilistic modeling technique that runs thousands of scenarios with random variable inputs to quantify uncertainty and assess risk distributions"

title: Outside View Inside View
description: "Forecast by comparing to similar past cases (outside view) instead of analyzing unique project details (inside view) - cures planning fallacy"

title: Sensitivity Analysis
description: "Systematic testing of how changes in input variables (assumptions) affect output results, revealing which factors drive outcomes and where model risk is concentrated."

title: Superforecasting
description: "Make probabilistic predictions when strategic decisions require accurate risk assessment"

title: Tetlocks 10 Commandments
description: "Improve forecast accuracy by following Philip Tetlock's 10 evidence-based principles from superforecaster research distinguishing top 2% predictors"

title: Bayesian
description: "Update beliefs systematically based on new evidence using probabilistic reasoning. Use when estimating probabilities, learning from data, or making decisions under uncertainty."

title: Fermi Estimation
description: "Make order-of-magnitude estimates for unknown quantities by decomposing into known or estimable factors. Use for capacity planning, cost estimation, market sizing, and technical feasibility assessment."

title: In Bets
description: "Frame decisions as probability bets instead of certainties - separate decision quality from outcome quality to avoid resulting bias"

title: Probabilistic
description: "Express confidence in ranges, update predictions with new information, and track calibration over time. Use for project estimation, risk assessment, and decision making under uncertainty."

title: Wisdom Of Crowds Aggregation
description: "Combine diverse independent estimates to produce more accurate predictions than any single expert, when conditions support collective intelligence"

title: Current Reality Tree
description: "A logical diagram that maps cause-effect relationships between undesirable effects to identify root causes that drive most organizational problems"

title: Fault Tree Analysis
description: "Top-down deductive methodology for analyzing system failures by mapping logical relationships between faults, subsystems, and redundant safety elements using Boolean logic diagrams"

title: Fishbone Diagram
description: "Visually map all potential causes of a problem across structured categories to systematically identify root causes through team collaboration"

title: Five Whys Plus
description: "Enhanced root cause analysis with explicit bias guards and stopping criteria. Use for incident post-mortems, bug investigations, and process failures where standard 5 Whys might mislead."

title: Kepner Tregoe
description: "Systematic rational process for complex problem analysis, decision making, and risk assessment. Use for high-stakes engineering decisions, root cause analysis beyond 5 Whys, and multi-factor evaluations requiring structured criteria."

title: Eisenhower Matrix
description: "Prioritize tasks by urgency and importance—focus on important but not urgent work to prevent firefighting"

title: Rice Prioritization
description: "Scoring framework using Reach, Impact, Confidence, and Effort to objectively prioritize product features and projects"

title: Schelling Fence
description: "Strategic precommitment to defend an arbitrary line on a slippery slope. Use when you face a continuum from acceptable to unacceptable and need a conspicuous, defensible boundary."

title: Bounded Rationality
description: "Apply Herbert Simon's Bounded Rationality and satisficing to make good-enough decisions under real-world constraints. Use for design decisions under time pressure, recognizing cognitive limits, and setting appropriate stopping criteria."

title: Cynefin
description: "Classify problems by complexity domain (clear, complicated, complex, chaotic) and match approach to domain. Use for choosing methodologies, problem framing, and process design."

title: Inversion
description: "Approach problems backward by identifying paths to failure, then systematically avoiding them. Use for risk identification, planning, and avoiding obvious mistakes."

title: Lindy Effect
description: "For non-perishable things, future life expectancy is proportional to current age. Use for technology selection, evaluating frameworks/libraries, and predicting tool longevity."

title: Margin Of Safety
description: "Build in buffers for unknown unknowns and don't optimize to the edge. Use for capacity planning, deadline estimation, architecture design, and risk management."

title: Ooda
description: "Rapid decision-making loop for dynamic situations. Use for incident response, competitive scenarios, time-sensitive decisions, and situations requiring quick adaptation."

title: Pre Mortem
description: "Imagine a project has failed and work backward to identify why. Use at project kickoffs, before major decisions, or when optimism may be obscuring risks."

title: Red Team
description: "Deliberately attack your own plans, systems, and assumptions to find weaknesses before adversaries or reality does. Use for security review, architecture validation, plan stress-testing, and pre-launch preparation."

title: Regret Minimization
description: "Project to your future self and ask what you would regret not doing. Use for career decisions, strategic pivots, risk-taking choices, and life-changing decisions."

title: Reversibility
description: "Classify decisions by reversibility and match decision process to decision type. Use for technology choices, architecture decisions, process changes, and hiring decisions."

title: Via Negativa
description: "Improve by removal rather than addition. Focus on what to stop doing, eliminate the negative, and subtract complexity. Use for system simplification, process improvement, and feature prioritization."

title: Anchoring
description: "First information disproportionately influences judgments and decisions, even when the initial value is arbitrary or irrelevant"

title: Availability Heuristic
description: "Correct probability and frequency judgments distorted by mentally available examples by seeking base rate data before relying on vivid anecdotes"

title: Confirmation Bias
description: "Combat the tendency to seek evidence supporting existing beliefs by actively searching for disconfirming data and treating opinions as testable hypotheses"

title: Dunning Kruger Effect
description: "Low-skill individuals overestimate their competence because they lack the metacognitive ability to recognize their own incompetence"

title: Fundamental Attribution Error
description: "Over-attributing others' behavior to their character while under-weighting situational factors that shape their actions"

title: Halo Effect
description: "One positive trait creates a global positive impression, influencing judgments about unrelated characteristics"

title: Hindsight Bias
description: "The tendency to perceive past events as more predictable than they actually were, leading to distorted learning and overconfidence"

title: Sunk Cost Fallacy
description: "Continuing an endeavor due to previously invested resources (time, money, effort) rather than current and future costs and benefits, escalating commitment to failing courses of action"

title: Circle Of Competence
description: "Know the boundaries of your expertise and operate within them. Use when evaluating opportunities, making decisions outside your domain, or assessing when to defer to experts."

title: Debiasing
description: "Systematic checklist to identify and counteract cognitive biases in decision-making. Use before major decisions, when evaluating recommendations, or when stakes are high."

title: Dual Process
description: "Apply Kahneman's Dual-Process Theory to recognize when to trust intuition vs engage deliberate analysis. Use for high-stakes decisions, error-prone contexts, or when balancing speed vs accuracy."

title: Map Territory
description: "Recognize limits of mental models and diagrams. Use when models diverge from reality, debugging expectation mismatches, or questioning abstraction accuracy."
